This vignette demonstrates a tidy workflow for Stan models using helpers in tidyrethinking.

## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyrethinking)
library(dplyr)
```

## 1. Locate an installed Stan model

```{r}
stan_model_path("08_mHMC")
```

## 2. Compile (cmdstanr)

Compilation requires the cmdstanr package and a working CmdStan installation. We never install or manage CmdStan for you.

```{r}
if (rlang::is_installed("cmdstanr") && isTRUE(try(cmdstanr::cmdstan_available(error_on_NA = FALSE), silent = TRUE))) {
  cm <- compile_stan_model("08_mHMC")
  cm$model
} else {
  message("cmdstanr or CmdStan not available; skipping compile.")
}
```

## 3. Sample and return tidy draws

```{r}
if (exists("cm")) {
  # Supply appropriate data list for the model; using empty list as placeholder
  draws <- sample_stan_model(cm, data = list(), chains = 2, iter_warmup = 100, iter_sampling = 100, seed = 123)
  head(draws)
}
```
